headline: ASTEROIDS: the small saucer learned to shoot
lede: The 1979 cabinet never sent a rookie saucer and a veteran saucer at the same score — the small UFO's aim tightened the longer it survived. The arcade's ships always shot to one law; now leaving an alarm alive on the field is a mistake, and killing saucers fast is the optimal play again.

notes.text: Small saucer shot error starts at the large UFO's ±0.55 spray and eases monotone to the shipped ±0.15 floor over 10 seconds of its own life — same dice count, no new field, mature shots are the verbatim old law. 113 gates, 29/29 mutants, 40-seed watch floors hold.

The never-dry picker was aiming at phantoms: parseGaps counted `### Restored in …` subsections as open gaps (ADVENTURE scored 13 where the honest number was 1). h3 now ends the section, Restored-bullets decline, and idle-kick aims at real work again.

Two pre-existing driver mutants went un-mortal when rookie-spray eased early pressure — measured before moving anything: clean banks 12/12 fast waves, both mutants bank 11. The fast floor rose to the full sweep's own 40/40 law.
Red main cleared mid-shift: three stale GALAGA attract anchors (slot a re-pinned #3557) plus a rollercheck edge line that measures 70/70 green at the fix sha. A fresh nightly is proving it on CI.
